integrity: This is a deterministic mathematical result for a specified idealized model. Published studies motivated the question but did not calibrate or validate the model. No claim of authorship, experimental validation, or independent audit is made.
scientific_limitations: Two symmetric point crop units and one freely movable point source
Independent Poisson effective-visit counts, equal crop value, exponential distance attenuation
No landscape barriers, visitation competition, pollen-transfer correlations, dynamic growth, or empirical calibration
Universal statement proved analytically; numerical tests supply only supplementary checks
Historical priority provisional, and no independent external validation has been performed
title: Three placement regimes versus universal balanced coverage in a two-crop pollination model
